text:
Tess (Design): small design sync 1 export action in trace header gets hidden on narrow screens. proposal: remove inline snapshot button, put "Export" into drilldown kebab and show an "Export options" modal.
Marco (Product): +1. customer asked for correlation_id in exports; missing that breaks dashboards.
Dee (Eng runtime): backend stores corr ids but compact export excludes them. we can add a checkbox: Include correlation IDs & span metadata. default on for enterprise.
Samira (A11y): checkbox needs descriptive SR text. suggested aria-label: "Include correlation IDs and span metadata in export". Also preview must have aria-live description.
Tess (Design): modal sketch: Quick CSV (one-click) for <1MB traces; otherwise show options: radios Compact vs Full, the checkbox, small sample preview of first 3 columns, export CTA.
Marco (Product): telemetry: export_started {export_type, include_corr, trigger_location}.
Dee (Eng runtime): file-size guard: if estimated >10MB show warning and switch to async email delivery. export button should be disabled for async path and show info: "We'll email a download when ready."
Samira (A11y): keyboard order: focus preview -> radios -> checkbox -> export. export button must have aria-describedby linking to filesize warning when present. announce keyboard shortcut (E) via aria-live when focus is on trace list.
Tess (Design): copy suggestions: Compact 1 "Summary CSV 1 fewer columns, faster"; Full 1 "Complete trace export 1 includes correlation and span-level data". Quick CSV label: "Quick CSV 1 immediate, compact columns".
Dee (Eng runtime): dev note: add stable_column_order flag for API exports so scripts don't break when columns differ.
deploy-bot: ui:trace-export quickfix deployed to staging at 1716003420 :rocket:
Marco (Product): thanks 1 action items: Dee to wire checkbox + stable flag + async; Samira to provide final SR strings; Tess to update mock. reconvene in 24h for sign-off. :thumbsup:
